plan.summary: IBDB revival verdicts from the 2026-10-21 detect-revivals-ibdb run (12 proposals > the >5 gate). Revivals, sourced: La Boheme x3, Carmen, Porgy and Bess, Macbeth (Verdi), Othello, Miss Julie (Strindberg) -> isRevival true. Not revivals: Caroline (2025 MCC world premiere, Preston Max Allen), All The Way Home (new Ahrens/Flaherty/Galati musical, York NEW2NY), You Go On (matched IBDB Before You Go by word overlap). Flight (59E59, MB Adaptors) has no public description; an exact IBDB title match alone is not revival evidence, so it is marked checked with isRevival left unset. Provisional-venue audit (2026-10-22 run, BRO-5975): The Good Thief is a revival (Keen Company 2001), so isRevival true. Speculations extended to 2027-01-17 (Theatre Weekly). Arias with a Twist extended to 2026-12-20 (BroadwayWorld 2026-10-05). A Kidman Carol is a play (TDF listing). Playbill exemptions where the only Playbill page is another production: Mystic Pizza (page is the Riverside Vero Beach leg; existing source already names the Paper Mill proof), School Pictures 2023 (page is the 2026 Cherry Lane run), Cat on a Hot Tin Roof 2027 (only the 2003 vault page exists).
